reserveReview.rationale: Issuer factsheet dated July 31, 2026 reports CP 49.2%, CDs 25.1%, time deposits 17.6% and cash 8.0% of total net assets, 43 positions and USD 45m whole-fund size. Published weights sum to 99.9% because of rounding; no 0.1% asset or normalization is invented. WAM 41 days and WAL 59 days are measured averages, not maximum tenor. The factsheet identifies Class 1 ACC (FILQ-A), ISIN KYG3R61G1088 and a Moody's Aaa-mf fund assessment; its glossary explicitly says this is not a credit rating. These are issuer portfolio disclosures, not an independent token-to-fund reconciliation.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Security-level counterparties, current October composition and complete Class 1 ACC token-to-fund asset/liability reconciliation remain unavailable. July whole-fund size is not FILQ-A current token liabilities. Named custodians and auditors do not prove account-level custody allocation or financial assurance.
